BBCH_30_39.variable_label: Daily mean temperature >= 33.0 °C for 1.0 consecutive day
BBCH_30_39.threshold_text: Daily mean temperature >= 33.0 °C for 1.0 consecutive day
BBCH_30_39.note: Duration was relaxed relative to the original standard; not a global threshold.
BBCH_30_39.qualitative_impact: Heat-risk indicator during panicle initiation; the rule does not isolate a universal biological effect size.

BBCH_30_39.variable_label: Duration of complete submergence >= 7 days for 7 days of complete submergence
BBCH_30_39.threshold_text: Duration of complete submergence >= 7 days for 7 days of complete submergence
BBCH_30_39.note: Apply only when varietal susceptibility is known; sensitive varieties may die within 7 days, whereas SUB1 genotypes can tolerate 7–15 days.
BBCH_30_39.qualitative_impact: High mortality in sensitive varieties; SUB1 varieties showed greater survival.
BBCH_30_39.quantitative_impact: Popular sensitive varieties commonly died within 7 days; SUB1 conferred an advantage after 7–15 days.

BBCH_40_59.variable_label: Relative soil moisture <= 75.0 % for 10.0 consecutive days
BBCH_40_59.threshold_text: Relative soil moisture <= 75.0 % for 10.0 consecutive days
BBCH_40_59.note: The operational soil-moisture definition must be matched before transfer.
BBCH_40_59.qualitative_impact: Sustained soil-moisture deficit can constrain reproductive development and seasonal rice performance.

BBCH_40_59.threshold_text: Daily mean temperature <= 20.0 °C for 1.0 consecutive day
BBCH_40_59.note: Relaxed duration and regional scope; not globally validated.
BBCH_40_59.qualitative_impact: Cold exposure around booting or flowering can impair reproductive development and seed set.

BBCH_40_59.variable_label: Daily total precipitation >= 25.0 mm/day for 1.0 consecutive day
BBCH_40_59.threshold_text: Daily total precipitation >= 25.0 mm/day for 1.0 consecutive day
BBCH_40_59.note: Based on a local Chengdu standard; rainfall is an exposure indicator, not a universal damage threshold.
BBCH_40_59.qualitative_impact: Heavy rainfall can disrupt panicle emergence or flowering and, during filling, reduce radiation and increase lodging or disease pressure.

BBCH_60_69.note: SE 0.2 °C; significant seed-set reduction; exposure durations differ among experiments.
BBCH_60_69.qualitative_impact: Seed set is significantly reduced above the modeled daytime flowering threshold.

BBCH_60_69.variable_label: Nighttime temperature > 31.2 °C for more than 7 consecutive days
BBCH_60_69.threshold_text: Nighttime temperature > 31.2 °C for more than 7 consecutive days
BBCH_60_69.note: SE 0.2 °C; the reported duration is not a maximum tolerable duration.
BBCH_60_69.qualitative_impact: Night heat during flowering is associated with significantly reduced seed set.

BBCH_60_69.variable_label: Mean chamber temperature during anthesis <= 17 °C for 5 consecutive flowering days
BBCH_60_69.threshold_text: Mean chamber temperature during anthesis <= 17 °C for 5 consecutive flowering days
BBCH_60_69.note: 17 °C was the treatment mean (20/14 °C maximum/minimum), not a universal threshold; response depended on cultivar.
BBCH_60_69.qualitative_impact: Reduced pollen germination and spikelet fertility, especially in sensitive cultivars.
BBCH_60_69.quantitative_impact: The source reports cultivar-dependent reductions in pollen germination and spikelet fertility.

BBCH_60_69.variable_label: Soil water potential at 15 cm depth <= -30 kPa; during flowering; exact exposure duration was not reported
BBCH_60_69.threshold_text: Soil water potential at 15 cm depth <= -30 kPa; during flowering; exact exposure duration was not reported
BBCH_60_69.note: The treatment was maintained at −30 ±5 kPa; it does not estimate the first damaging point or maximum tolerable duration.
BBCH_60_69.qualitative_impact: Fewer spikelets and filled grains, resulting in lower yield.
BBCH_60_69.quantitative_impact: Yield −23.2% to −24.0%; spikelets −18% to −21%; filled grains −19%.

BBCH_70_79.variable_label: Daily mean temperature <= 17.0 °C for 1.0 consecutive day
BBCH_70_79.threshold_text: Daily mean temperature <= 17.0 °C for 1.0 consecutive day
BBCH_70_79.note: Relaxed duration and regional scope; not globally validated.
BBCH_70_79.qualitative_impact: Cold exposure during grain filling can slow development and impair grain formation.

BBCH_70_79.threshold_text: Daily total precipitation >= 25.0 mm/day for 1.0 consecutive day

BBCH_10_19.threshold_text: Duration of complete submergence >= 7 days for 7 days of complete submergence

BBCH_00_09.variable_label: Germination temperature >= 38 °C for 24 hours of continuous exposure
BBCH_00_09.threshold_text: Germination temperature >= 38 °C for 24 hours of continuous exposure
BBCH_00_09.note: 38 °C was the lowest tested treatment with extreme inhibition; 35 °C did not produce a significant effect. Betaine modified the response.
BBCH_00_09.qualitative_impact: Strong inhibition of germination and seed protrusion, with hormonal and oxidative disruption.
BBCH_00_09.quantitative_impact: At 38 °C, betaine increased germination 43.77-fold relative to the stressed untreated control, indicating nearly suppressed baseline germination.

BBCH_80_99.variable_label: Daily mean temperature during grain filling and ripening > 28 °C; during the grain-filling/ripening period; critical duration not isolated
BBCH_80_99.threshold_text: Daily mean temperature during grain filling and ripening > 28 °C; during the grain-filling/ripening period; critical duration not isolated
BBCH_80_99.note: The paper classifies >28 °C as heat during grain filling but does not estimate a duration-specific breakpoint.
BBCH_80_99.qualitative_impact: Lower grain weight and milling quality, with increased chalkiness.

R1.note: SE 0.4 °C; modeled threshold for significant seed-set reduction.
R1.qualitative_impact: Seed set is significantly reduced above the modeled daytime flowering threshold.

R1.variable_label: Nighttime temperature > 27.3 °C for more than 7 consecutive days
R1.threshold_text: Nighttime temperature > 27.3 °C for more than 7 consecutive days
R1.note: SE 1.3 °C; the reported duration is not a maximum tolerable duration.
R1.qualitative_impact: Night heat around silking and pollination is associated with reduced seed set.

R4_R5.note: The 39.4–41.5 °C treatment caused damage but does not estimate damage onset.
R4_R5.qualitative_impact: Short-term heat during effective grain filling reduces photosynthesis, grain weight and yield.

R4_R5.hazard: High nighttime temperature during grain filling
R4_R5.variable_label: Minimum/night temperature during effective grain filling >= 28 °C for 18 consecutive nights beginning 15 days after silking
R4_R5.threshold_text: Minimum/night temperature during effective grain filling >= 28 °C for 18 consecutive nights beginning 15 days after silking
R4_R5.stress_type: High nighttime temperature during grain filling
R4_R5.note: 28 °C was the lowest treatment producing significant loss in the sensitive hybrid; another hybrid responded significantly at 30 °C.
R4_R5.qualitative_impact: Reduced yield and altered starch, lipid and protein composition.
R4_R5.quantitative_impact: The sensitive hybrid showed significant yield loss at 28 °C; response varied by hybrid and temperature.

VE.variable_label: Minimum temperature during emergence < 6 °C for 2 hours per episode; 2, 4 and 6 hours were compared
VE.threshold_text: Minimum temperature during emergence < 6 °C for 2 hours per episode; 2, 4 and 6 hours were compared
VE.note: Response depends strongly on soil moisture and exposure duration.
VE.qualitative_impact: Delayed and uneven emergence with reduced dry-matter accumulation.
VE.quantitative_impact: Temperatures below 6 °C significantly reduced emergence; at ≤2 °C, final emergence was below 50% in unfavorable moisture combinations.

V1_V6.variable_label: Soil water potential <= -0.51 MPa for 4 days after irrigation was withheld in 15-day-old plants
V1_V6.threshold_text: Soil water potential <= -0.51 MPa for 4 days after irrigation was withheld in 15-day-old plants
V1_V6.note: The threshold represents leaf-growth inhibition, not a direct yield-loss threshold.
V1_V6.qualitative_impact: Leaf elongation was inhibited; root growth was inhibited later under more severe drying.
V1_V6.quantitative_impact: Leaf inhibition began on day 4 below −0.51 MPa; root inhibition occurred on days 5–6 between −0.63 and −0.81 MPa.

V7_VT.variable_label: Day/night temperature during tasseling >= 38 °C daytime for 15 consecutive days under a 38/30 °C day/night regime
V7_VT.threshold_text: Day/night temperature during tasseling >= 38 °C daytime for 15 consecutive days under a 38/30 °C day/night regime
V7_VT.note: A single severe treatment was evaluated; it is not a universal damage-onset threshold.
V7_VT.qualitative_impact: Reduced growth, photosynthesis, nutrient uptake and yield formation.
V7_VT.quantitative_impact: Significant effects on growth and yield components; magnitude depended on hybrid and interaction with drought.

R2.variable_label: Day/night temperature after pollination >= 42 °C daytime for 6 days to the first significant response; treatment continued until harvest
R2.threshold_text: Day/night temperature after pollination >= 42 °C daytime for 6 days to the first significant response; treatment continued until harvest
R2.note: Severe treatment without a temperature gradient; the complete exposure continued to harvest.
R2.qualitative_impact: Lower seed set, grain-filling rate, thousand-kernel weight and starch accumulation.
R2.quantitative_impact: Significant phenotypic differences appeared 6–8 days after pollination.

R3.variable_label: Day/night temperature after pollination >= 42 °C daytime for 6 days to the first significant response; treatment continued until harvest
R3.threshold_text: Day/night temperature after pollination >= 42 °C daytime for 6 days to the first significant response; treatment continued until harvest
R3.note: Severe treatment without a temperature gradient; the complete exposure continued to harvest.
R3.qualitative_impact: Lower seed set, grain-filling rate, thousand-kernel weight and starch accumulation.
R3.quantitative_impact: Significant phenotypic differences appeared 6–8 days after pollination.

R6.variable_label: Wind speed > 15 m/s; gust or wind event; duration not reported
R6.threshold_text: Wind speed > 15 m/s; gust or wind event; duration not reported
R6.note: 15 m/s marks increasing cultivar separation, not a universal stalk-breaking threshold.
R6.qualitative_impact: Stalk breakage, lodging and greater losses under delayed harvest.
R6.quantitative_impact: Maximum stalk resistance occurred 16–24 days after physiological maturity; lodging increased with delayed harvest.

Z60_69.note: SE 0.5 °C; modeled threshold for significant seed-set reduction.
Z60_69.qualitative_impact: Seed set is significantly reduced above the modeled daytime anthesis threshold.

Z60_69.variable_label: Nighttime temperature > 19.6 °C for more than 7 consecutive days
Z60_69.threshold_text: Nighttime temperature > 19.6 °C for more than 7 consecutive days
Z60_69.note: SE 2.7 °C; the reported duration is not a maximum tolerable duration.
Z60_69.qualitative_impact: Night heat during anthesis is associated with significantly reduced seed set.

Z60_69.variable_label: Duration of soil waterlogging >= 3 days for 3 consecutive days beginning at Zadoks 65
Z60_69.threshold_text: Duration of soil waterlogging >= 3 days for 3 consecutive days beginning at Zadoks 65
Z60_69.note: Three days affected later photosynthesis, but the largest yield damage occurred after 6–9 days; one variety was tested.
Z60_69.qualitative_impact: Accelerated senescence and reduced assimilation and yield.
Z60_69.quantitative_impact: Nine days reduced final yield 28%; 6 and 9 days reduced thousand-grain weight 11% and 19% at 28 days after anthesis.

Z60_69.variable_label: Minimum canopy air temperature <= -3.5 °C; nighttime event; critical duration was not quantified
Z60_69.threshold_text: Minimum canopy air temperature <= -3.5 °C; nighttime event; critical duration was not quantified
Z60_69.note: Severity depends on exposure duration, ice nucleation and the difference between canopy, plant and weather-station temperature.
Z60_69.qualitative_impact: Frost can injure reproductive tissues and developing grain after heading.
Z60_69.quantitative_impact: Damage was reported between −3.5 and −4.5 °C; plant temperature may be 1–3 °C below measured air temperature.

Z00_09.source: Akter e Islam 2017 (cita Gupta et al. 2013a)
Z00_09.note: Primary source still required; experimental treatment, not an alert threshold.
Z00_09.qualitative_impact: The treatment elicited seedling heat and oxidative-stress responses; it is not an onset threshold.

Z10_29.source: Akter e Islam 2017 (cita Gupta et al. 2013a)
Z10_29.note: Primary source still required; experimental treatment, not an alert threshold.
Z10_29.qualitative_impact: The treatment elicited seedling heat and oxidative-stress responses; it is not an onset threshold.

Z70_89.variable_label: Night-temperature anomaly above ambient >= 3.8 °C; every night from 50% anthesis to maturity
Z70_89.threshold_text: Night-temperature anomaly above ambient >= 3.8 °C; every night from 50% anthesis to maturity
Z70_89.note: +3.8 °C was an experimental treatment, not an absolute threshold; treated mean temperature was 22.1 °C versus 18.4 °C.
Z70_89.qualitative_impact: Shortened grain filling and reduced grain weight, grain number and yield.
Z70_89.quantitative_impact: Grain filling −3.33 days; grain weight −1.25%/°C; grain number −2.36%/°C; yield −3.58%/°C.

Z70_89.variable_label: Minimum canopy air temperature <= -3.5 °C; nighttime event; critical duration was not quantified
Z70_89.threshold_text: Minimum canopy air temperature <= -3.5 °C; nighttime event; critical duration was not quantified

Z30_39.variable_label: Reduction in volumetric soil moisture relative to control >= 45 % de reducción for 14 consecutive days during stem elongation
Z30_39.threshold_text: Reduction in volumetric soil moisture relative to control >= 45 % de reducción for 14 consecutive days during stem elongation
Z30_39.note: Expressed as relative VSMC reduction, not an absolute soil-moisture value transferable among soils.
Z30_39.qualitative_impact: Reduced tillering and altered hormonal response during stem elongation.
Z30_39.quantitative_impact: Tillers per plant decreased 50.0% and 63.6% in two varieties at a 45% VSMC reduction.

Z40_49.variable_label: Chamber temperature <= -2 °C for 24 hours of continuous exposure
Z40_49.threshold_text: Chamber temperature <= -2 °C for 24 hours of continuous exposure
Z40_49.note: −2 °C was a severe treatment; 0 and 2 °C were also tested. Chamber temperature is not equivalent to standard weather-station temperature.
Z40_49.qualitative_impact: Inhibited spikelet development and delayed floret growth.
Z40_49.quantitative_impact: Significant changes occurred in enzymes and regulators associated with grain number and weight.

Z40_49.variable_label: Day/night temperature during booting >= 35 °C daytime for 24 one 24-hour exposure under a 35/30 °C regime
Z40_49.threshold_text: Day/night temperature during booting >= 35 °C daytime for 24 one 24-hour exposure under a 35/30 °C regime
Z40_49.note: Severe regime relative to 20/15 °C; response depended on genotype and exact stage.
Z40_49.qualitative_impact: Reduced seed set and grain number, with a sensitivity peak at GS41–45.
Z40_49.quantitative_impact: Relative seed set fell below 80% in sensitive genotypes after a single exposure.

Z90_99.variable_label: Artificial rainfall intensity >= 5 mm/h for 8 continuous hours at 45 days after heading
Z90_99.threshold_text: Artificial rainfall intensity >= 5 mm/h for 8 continuous hours at 45 days after heading
Z90_99.note: Applied about 10 days before maturity and followed by >90% humidity; effects depend on cultivar dormancy.
Z90_99.qualitative_impact: Greater risk of pre-harvest sprouting, elevated moisture and deterioration of flour quality.
Z90_99.quantitative_impact: The source identifies 40–45 days after heading and more than 8 hours of rainfall as a critical window.

ALL.note: Seasonal US association, not a phase-specific universal threshold.
ALL.qualitative_impact: Daily heat above 30 °C is associated with yield loss, particularly in rainfed US systems.
ALL.quantitative_impact: Up to 6% yield loss per additional day above 30 °C

VE_VC.note: Do not use as a mortality threshold or automatic field alert.
VE_VC.qualitative_impact: Upper modeled cardinal temperature for germination rate; not a death threshold or field-alert trigger.

VE_VC.variable_label: Flood duration > 3 days for 3 critical duration; damage increased beyond 3 days
VE_VC.threshold_text: Flood duration > 3 days for 3 critical duration; damage increased beyond 3 days
VE_VC.note: Responses varied by year; some short exposures partly offset drought or heat. Hydrologic conditions require local validation.
VE_VC.qualitative_impact: Pod number, dry matter and yield declined when flooding exceeded the critical duration.
VE_VC.quantitative_impact: After 9 days, relative yield was 7.1% at flowering–pod set, 15.6% at branching and 48.4% at seedling stage.

R5.hazard: High nighttime temperature during seed filling
R5.variable_label: Night temperature during seed filling >= 28 °C; 12 hours per night during stages R5–R7
R5.threshold_text: Night temperature during seed filling >= 28 °C; 12 hours per night during stages R5–R7
R5.stress_type: High nighttime temperature during seed filling
R5.note: 28 °C was a treatment compared with 18 °C, not an estimated breakpoint; response varied by cultivar.
R5.qualitative_impact: Reduced yield and altered non-structural carbohydrates during seed filling.
R5.quantitative_impact: The source reports significant yield and seed-composition responses that varied among three cultivars.

R5.variable_label: Flood duration > 6 days for 6 critical duration for 100-grain weight
R5.threshold_text: Flood duration > 6 days for 6 critical duration for 100-grain weight
R5.note: The effect depended on year and stage; a clear reduction was generally observed after 9 days.
R5.qualitative_impact: Reduced 100-grain weight, with greatest sensitivity during flowering–pod set.
R5.quantitative_impact: After 9 days, 100-grain weight during flowering–pod set was 37.8% of the control.
